userStories.title: Fix Actor Category Display Hierarchy
acceptanceCriteria: List Row view for Actor categories fetches and displays 'Actor Name' in the primary headline slot
Movie Title is moved to the secondary sub-headline slot
Year remains visible and formatted correctly next to movie title (e.g., 'Movie Title (2025)')
userStories.notes: UI/UX Improvement - Invert current hierarchy to prioritize Actor name

userStories.title: Implement Dashboard List View Toggle
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard includes a segmented control or toggle button to switch between 'Grid' and 'List' modes
State variable created to manage and persist the selected view preference
List mode renders using the compact 'ListRow' component (reused from Category view) for consistency
userStories.notes: New Feature - Users need a compact view option

userStories.title: Add Dashboard Sorting Logic
acceptanceCriteria: Sort Menu (Picker/Menu) added to the Dashboard navigation bar
Selected sort order updates the movie list immediately
userStories.notes: New Feature - Requires sort state management

userStories.title: Fix Ballot Menu Image Loading
acceptanceCriteria: Ballot model correctly passes 'posterPath' or 'imageURL' to the image loader
Images render successfully within the Ballot View cells
Fallback placeholder image displays if the URL is nil or the load fails
userStories.notes: Bug Fix - High priority visual regression

userStories.title: Fix Year Number Formatting
acceptanceCriteria: Text view displaying the release year uses Verbatim string interpolation or specific NumberFormatter
Years display as '2025' instead of '2,025' (commas removed)
userStories.notes: Bug Fix - Cosmetic number formatting issue (Fixed in US-001)
